name: LegalOne
description: French *annonces légales* (legal notices) publishing — accountants and companies file required notices with competitive rates and compliance baked in. Bootstrapped, France.

mentions.evidence: ~$10.7k L30, ~$93k all-time, MRR listed as none / no active subscriptions (pay-per-notice model). Founded Oct 2025, France. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Digitize a mandatory local filing (legal notices, permits, company registry forms) and sell through accountants who already do the paperwork.

whyItPrints: Legal notices are mandatory, price-sensitive, and accountant-distributed. Transaction revenue (not seat MRR) with ~$11k L30 and ~917 users claimed — classic country compliance marketplace.
